concerns.text: FR-001 requires computing structural descriptors (atomic radius, packing fraction) and plan.md Phase 1 step 3 explicitly tasks 'Parse CIF structures using pymatgen to compute atomic_radius and packing_fraction', but T001's preprocess step only splits, applies PCA, and excludes rows with 'missing required descriptors' — no task computes the descriptors or parses CIFs. The exclusion logic references features nothing creates.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002, T003 vs spec.md:FR-001/US-1, constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: Spec and plan describe predicting three properties (formation energy, bulk modulus, band gap); constitution Principle VI budgets 'UQ evaluation ≤ 20 minutes per property'. T002/T003 train and infer only on formation_energy. This is a silent scope narrowing with no documented staging in the spec — a retroactive narrowing violation.

SC-004 requires ECE consistency across seeds 42/43/44 (and across inducing-point initializations for the GP). T002 trains the ensemble once with fixed member seeds 42–46 and T003 runs Sparse GP 'seed-independent, run once and reused', so per-seed ECE and ece_cv are only meaningful for MC-Dropout. The SC-004 evidence for ensemble and GP is vacuous as tasked.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs constitution.md:Principle VI, plan.md:Performance Goals
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI mandates training ≤ 30 minutes and UQ evaluation ≤ 20 minutes per property; plan.md restates these as performance goals. No task enforces or measures these sub-budgets — T007 only implements the 5-hour total timeout, so a run violating Principle VI passes all task verifications.

Spec's GP-convergence edge case requires falling back to 'a standard GP with full inducing points'; T002 (and plan.md) instead fall back to 200 inducing points or mark the run partial. The fallback strategy contradicts the spec's stated behavior with no recorded justification or spec amendment.

Method-name enums disagree: calibration_metric.schema.yaml requires 'deep_ensemble' while prediction_output.schema.yaml and T005's best_uq_method.txt use 'ensemble'. T005 must conform to the former while T003's CSVs use the latter — a guaranteed inconsistency. Reconcile the schemas or specify the mapping in the task.

FR-005 requires reporting 'reconstruction variance' and T003 writes gp_reconstruction_variance.json, but neither plan.md, data-model.md, nor the task defines what reconstruction variance is or how it is computed (PCA reconstruction error? GP posterior variance?). The acceptance criterion is unverifiable as specified.

plan.md says PCA should 'retain >90% variance' with free component count; T001 hard-codes 20 components AND asserts ≥0.90 explained variance. If 20 components are insufficient the two conditions conflict with no stated resolution order (e.g., increase components until ≥0.90).

T003 writes both per-seed files results/uq_predictions_seed_<seed>.csv and per-method files results/predictions/uq_predictions_*.csv without stating which seed the per-method files correspond to or whether they are seed-aggregated; prediction_output.schema.yaml has no seed column, leaving three output files ambiguous.

The timeout unit test ('a sleep past the limit triggers the exception') is specified against the 5-hour config limit with no short test-mode limit parameter, so the test as written is impractical; allow injecting a small limit for testing.
